items.author: nikkinightly.bsky.social
items.context: The alt text for Cyberia 2 was mistakenly written wrong. It's Cyberia not Siberia. The first game was released on MS-DOS and that's how I played it. The second game was released on MS-DOS and windows. I don't remember which version I had.
items.text: Cyberia on MS-DOS is a great memory. Those pre-rendered cutscenes felt like the future back then.
